blocks.html: GRG Builder makes a GRG (Gridded Reference Graphic — a KMZ) from a snapshot of high-resolution map imagery. The grid can also carry map items, a scale, compass, crosshair and an MGRS grid.

slides.title: Create a GRG
slides.html: Pick a map source from Maps & Favorites and pan/zoom to your area of interest. Select the GRG Builder icon on the Creation tab, then Add GRG (+) to drop a grid on the map. Select Add GRG again to place more. To rename a grid, select Edit GRG (pencil) > Change GRG Name > Rename.

slides.title: Edit the grid
slides.html: Select Edit GRG > Edit GRG Components > Edit Grid. Move Grid recenters it; change Height x Width and Spacing to resize the cells (or Add Size for a custom layout), and set the grid Color and opacity with the slider. To reshape the footprint, use Redefine GRG: right-click a corner, left-click a new point, then Done Editing to save.

slides.title: Label the grid
slides.html: Open Grid Label to letter and number the grid. Choose Alphanumeric, MGRS or Both; for MGRS, set the orientation, colors and Precision. Toggle labels with the Show Grid Labels checkbox.
